family_reports.body: I’ve lost precious time with my children because I was forced to pay a stranger to pretend she knows what’s best for my children. The judge clearly doesn’t know the constitution and continues to violate the rights of families everyday. Mary and Bonfiglio ruined their own reputations by the corruption they’ve created.
The system has allowed my girls to be in the custody of child abusers

This system tore my family apart with false accusations, ignored evidence, and let an absent parent take my child without protection or due process. It has cost us years of lost time, emotional damage, and a bond I’ve fought every day to rebuild.
Judge Bonfiglio and GAL Mary Raatz belong in jail. There are hundreds of us demanding these people are deeply investigated and we won’t stop until they are.
This judge denied my children proper financial support from their father and also put the burden of providing insurance on me.

I'm going through a high conflict divorce because of feelings. Mother filed a fake protection order on me June 3rd to try to get the courts to keep me from seeing our daughter but ordered me to pay child support. Judge bonfiglio put the protection order with the divorce when it should be separate. I turned in evidence at that time last June and the order still hasn't been heard. So I've gone a year without being able to have any communication with our daughter which is going to make it harder trying to build our bond back since she has been under the influence of negativity. I've missed time and it's costing me and haven't gotten anywhere. I've turned in proof from witnesses stating that mom is out to ruin me. With that order they took away my rights to carry and protect myself and my family. There's a bunch more. This is wrong on all levels. Girls need their dad's without feeling guilty

public_comments.comment_text: Judge Bonfiglio uses aggressive, hostile and abusive language towards pro se litigants. He’s an embarrassment to the entire county of Elkhart. He gave custody to an abuser without due process. He ignores constitutional rights of parents and families. He would rather destroy families than actually obey the oath he took. I’ve never witnessed a more unhinged judge in my life. He is a disgrace to judges everywhere. He should have removed from the bench years ago, he’s almost 80 years old. He DOES NOT care about children or families at all. He threatens, yells and refuses due process. Judge Bonfiglio is ruining Elkhart County. His family should be embarrassed by his pure lack of empathy for families in his county.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He makes rulings without any due process. He orders GALS and approves their recommendations without any evidence. He orders parents to be evaluated by psychologists that cost thousands who work exclusively for the court. He will issue warrants, contempt threats and fees without due process. He recently gave a father who had 2 lifetime sex offender convictions against 2 young boys, full custody of his young son. That father ended up torturing and killing his young son after receiving full custody. The father has been convicted of murder. The need wont share that it was a family court judge that gave this monster full custody:
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: A lawyer took me to the wrong courtroom, and when we realized and went to the right courtroom, the judge told me that their mind was made up and there was nothing that they could do. I would have to re-file to have that court redone and I said what do I do if my son‘s being abused and the lady said report it to CPS so I did and then a month later she turned around and gave him full custody They didn’t wanna listen to me. I told him my son was being abused. No one listened a month later Franklin Elmore was given custody. A year later, Franklin Elmore and his wife killed my son.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He literally leaves all the work to GAL. He the only person that could access the whole trial from the DCS chins case to verify all my claims that I already won. Disregarded what that judge said to keep my daughter w her other siblings and me at 50 50. Like we had been for the prior years up to this.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Found me in contempt for placing my son in therapy at the recommendation of the detective overseeing the sexual abuse case for my son. Found me in contempt for staying home with my son rather than sending him to preschool despite my husband providing for our family. Ignored sexual abuse concerns.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Denied my motion without a hearing and ignored evidence in my custody modification case. Allowed the father to have temporary custody of the child based on hearsay without requiring a court order and without being accountable for returning the child to my custody.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: He lied on my dad countless times for things he didn’t do and took us out of our home for false allegations. Repeatedly lied on my dad for things he never did. Got us put on foster care for false allegations.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Violated yet another fit mothers due rights process. There was no evidence sworn and no testimonies given. Judgment was made on a 15 minute contested hearing with a flawed biased gal report.
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Approved a false protection order that's keeping myself away from my daughter with no facts from the athe mother. Not hearing Truth that's supported by facts filed. Giving mother everything
public_comments.author: Anonymous parent

public_comments.comment_text: Removed child at status hearing based solely on father and gal testimony. Did not have a trial based on allegations no evidence. Due process violated at status hearing.

public_comments.comment_text: He allowed my ex-husband to fail to comply with providing proof of income for a child support hearing and just took my ex-husband's claim for his income as fact.
